name: Attendance Tracking
description: Implements attendance tracking including clock-in/out, work schedules, overtime calculation, and attendance reports.
outputPattern: Attendance model, API routes, and attendance service
systemPromptAddition:
## Attendance Skill
- Track: employeeId, date, clockIn, clockOut, totalHours, status
- Status: present, absent, late, early-leave, on-leave
- Support multiple clock-in/out per day
- Calculate overtime (hours > scheduled hours)
- Integrate with schedules for expected work hours
- Generate attendance summary reports
